overview: Western Indian coastal state. ~70 million people. Highly industrialized, urbanizing fast, semi-arid to arid climate in large parts, longest coastline in India (~1600 km).

strengths: Petrochemicals and refining (Jamnagar hosts the world's largest refinery)
Textiles and apparel (Surat is a global synthetic textile hub)
Diamond cutting and polishing (Surat processes ~90% of world's diamonds)
Ports and logistics (Mundra, Kandla — India's busiest ports)
Ceramics (Morbi produces ~90% of India's ceramic tiles)
Renewable energy (among India's top states in solar and wind capacity)
Automobile manufacturing (Sanand belt: Tata, MG, and suppliers)
Semiconductors (Dholera fab, Sanand OSAT plants under construction)
major_projects: GIFT City (Gandhinagar) — international financial services centre
Dholera SIR — greenfield smart industrial city

characteristics: Semi-arid; irrigation-dependent (Narmada canal network, drip irrigation adoption)
Water scarcity in Saurashtra and Kutch; salinity ingress along coast
Large livestock population; Banni grasslands buffalo, Gir cattle
NOT suited to high-rainfall crops: rubber, tea, coffee, coconut-heavy or paddy-dominant systems

climate.type: Semi-arid to arid; hot summers (44°C+), erratic monsoon

issues: traffic congestion in Ahmedabad and Surat

notable_programs: Jyotigram Yojana (24x7 rural power with separated agri feeders)
Smart City missions in Ahmedabad, Surat, Vadodara, Rajkot, Gandhinagar, Dahod

departments.name: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat
Energy and Petro Chemicals Department, Gujarat
Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs Department, Gujarat
Legislative and Parliamentary Affairs Department, Gujarat
Narmada, Water Resources, Water Supply and Kalpsar Department, Gujarat
Panchayats and Rural Housing Department, Gujarat
Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat

needs_and_gaps: Groundwater recharge and water-use efficiency in agriculture
Air and effluent pollution control in industrial clusters (Vapi, Ankleshwar, Morbi)
Skilled workforce for semiconductors, EVs, and green hydrogen
Coastal resilience against cyclones and salinity
Primary healthcare staffing in tribal eastern belt
Heat-wave action planning (Ahmedabad pioneered India's first Heat Action Plan)
